fullPassage: Your body is equipped with systems designed to keep you safe from harm. In particular, your nervous system has an alarm system to protect you from threats. If you sense the building burning, your alarm sounds, telling you to get out. Likewise, if you burnt your hand on the stove, you would pull away. Short-lived pain from a possible injury is acute pain, but when pain becomes chronic, persisting for longer than three to six months, it behaves differently. With chronic pain, as with trauma and anxiety, there is a faulty alarm system that may go off when a metaphorical candle is lit. This can happen when you gently bump your arthritic knee or you feel the early signs of a headache and your mind envisions how it might ruin your day. With time, we can be sensitized to pain, so that lesser stimulation hurts more.

다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"continuing for a long time or recurring frequently"

det.korean: '오래 지속되거나 자주 재발하는' = chronic(만성적인).
det.analysis:
✅ ② chronic: '오래 지속되는' = 만성적인.
❌ ① acute: '급성의'는 단기적이므로 반대.
❌ ③ temporary: '일시적인'은 오래 지속과 반대.
❌ ④ mild: '가벼운'은 지속 기간과 무관.

questions.passage: With chronic pain, there is a faulty alarm system. With time, we can be __________ (sense) to pain, so that lesser stimulation hurts more.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: be + 과거분사 수동태: '통증에 민감해질 수 있다'.
det.analysis:
✅ sensitized: be sensitized to(~에 민감해지다). sense → sensitize → sensitized(수동태).
❌ sensing, sensitive: 문법적으로 가능하나 원문은 sensitized.

questions.passage: Short-lived pain from a possible injury is acute pain, but when pain becomes chronic, __________ (persist) for longer than three to six months, it behaves differently.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 분사구문: 만성 통증이 3~6개월 이상 '지속되면서'.
det.analysis:
✅ persisting: 분사구문(능동). 통증이 지속되는 것이므로 현재분사.
❌ persisted: 과거분사는 수동 의미이나 persist는 자동사.
❌ persistent: 형용사로 문법 구조 불일치.

questions.passage: Your body is equipped with systems designed to keep you safe from harm. In particular, your nervous system has an alarm system to protect you from threats. If you sense the building burning, your alarm sounds, telling you to get out. Likewise, if you burnt your hand on the stove, you would pull away. Short-lived pain from a possible injury is acute pain, but when pain becomes chronic, persisting for longer than three to six months, it behaves differently. With chronic pain, as with trauma and anxiety, there is a faulty alarm system that may __________ when a metaphorical candle is lit. This can happen when you gently bump your arthritic knee or you feel the early signs of a headache and your mind envisions how it might ruin your day. With time, we can be sensitized to pain, so that lesser stimulation hurts more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비유적 촛불이 켜졌을 때 결함 있는 경보가 '작동할(go off)' 수 있습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① go off: '경보가 울리다/작동하다'는 문맥 적절.
❌ ② pull away: '움츠리다'는 사람의 반응이지 경보 시스템의 동작이 아님.
❌ ③ get out: '나가다'는 경보 후 행동이지 경보 자체의 동작이 아님.
❌ ④ burn out: '소진되다'는 경보 작동과 무관.
det.tip: go off = (경보가) 울리다, 작동하다. set off도 동의 표현.

questions.passage: Your body is equipped with systems designed to keep you safe from harm. In particular, your nervous system has an alarm system to protect you from threats. If you sense the building burning, your alarm sounds, telling you to get out. Likewise, if you burnt your hand on the stove, you would pull away. Short-lived pain from a possible injury is acute pain, but when pain becomes chronic, persisting for longer than three to six months, it behaves differently. With chronic pain, as with trauma and anxiety, there is a faulty alarm system that may go off when a metaphorical candle is lit. This can happen when you gently bump your arthritic knee or you feel the early signs of a headache and your mind envisions how it might ruin your day. With time, we can be sensitized to pain, so that __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시간이 지나면 통증에 민감해져서 '더 약한 자극도 더 아프게 된다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ lesser stimulation hurts more: 민감해지면 약한 자극에도 더 큰 통증 = 원문과 일치.
❌ ① your alarm sounds telling you to get out: 경보가 울리는 것은 정상 반응 예시이지 민감화 결과가 아님.
❌ ② a metaphorical candle is lit: 비유적 촛불이 켜지는 것은 원인이지 so that 결과절이 아님.
❌ ④ you would pull away from the stove: 난로에서 움츠리는 것은 정상 반응이지 민감화 결과가 아님.
det.tip: sensitized = 민감해진. 핵심: 약한 자극(lesser stimulation) → 더 큰 통증(hurts more).
